title: inquiry-customer-goal/v2
description: One row per frozen resolution goal, classes A/B/C adjudicated. A row either EMITS a goal, is declared NO_GOAL by the product owner, or is still open (D/E/F) — never two, never none. Rows whose adjudicated outcome no longer implies the frozen closing_authority carry a declared legacy_conflict; the frozen resolution gold is NOT re-derived here.

q.description: the case id, as the resolution gold names it

goal.description: the goal id within the case, as the resolution gold names it

requested_outcome.description: null means NOT LABELLED — the row is ambiguous between two of the four and is adjudicated, never guessed

referent.description: what the goal is about, bound to a registry entry. UNRESOLVED is a real answer, not a parse failure.

basis.description: on what evidence the goal is attributed to the customer. There is no UNSTATED: a goal with no stated or directly implied outcome is not emitted, and absence is the observable.

explicit_constraints.description: how many values the customer actually said. A COUNT: the words themselves stay in the capture.

gold_closing_authority.description: carried from the frozen plan gold so the two representations can be compared row by row

gold_terminal.description: the frozen expected terminal, carried unchanged

adjudicated.description: false only for the rows still under adjudication (D/E/F)

emits_goal.description: whether a CustomerGoal exists for this row at all

no_goal_reason.description: set exactly when the product owner ruled NO_GOAL. NOT "ignore" — the case may still raise VOC/complaint signals elsewhere.

open_class.description: the ambiguity class, for rows still open

legacy_conflict.description: how the frozen resolution-gold row stopped following from the adjudicated goal. Declared, never suppressed.

gold_steps.description: the frozen required capabilities, carried so the conflict is checkable and so the DECISION prerequisite audit can be recomputed
